notes: Db2 Community Edition (privileged container, ~5 minutes first start). HADR (primary/standby log shipping) exists but needs two instances with matching configuration and a takeover procedure; not automated in this stack.

steps.name: BACKUP DATABASE (offline)
steps.cmd:
__o=$(mktemp); ( su - db2inst1 -c 'db2 -v '"'"'force applications all'"'"' || exit $?
sleep 2
db2 -v '"'"'deactivate db lab'"'"' || exit $?
db2 -v '"'"'backup db lab to /backups compress without prompting'"'"' || exit $?' ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 6 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc
steps.out:
deactivate db lab
SQL1495W  Deactivate database is successful, however, there is still a 
connection to the database.

offline_full.description: offline full image restored into a new database

online_incremental.tool: LOGARCHMETH1 + BACKUP ONLINE INCREMENTAL + RESTORE INCREMENTAL AUTOMATIC

pitr.note: table created after the online full comes from the incremental image

online_incremental.notes: archive logging (LOGARCHMETH1 DISK) enables online backups; TRACKMOD ON makes incremental images possible; the chain is resolved with INCREMENTAL AUTOMATIC

steps.name: LOGARCHMETH1 + TRACKMOD, offline backup
steps.cmd:
__o=$(mktemp); ( su - db2inst1 -c 'db2 -v '"'"'force applications all'"'"' || exit $?
sleep 2
db2 -v '"'"'deactivate db lab'"'"' || exit $?
db2 -v '"'"'update db cfg for lab using LOGARCHMETH1 DISK:/backups/logs/ TRACKMOD ON'"'"' || exit $?
db2 -v '"'"'backup db lab to /backups compress without prompting'"'"' || exit $?' ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 6 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc
steps.out:
backup db lab to /backups compress without prompting

Backup successful. The timestamp for this backup image is : 20260914103427

steps.name: BACKUP DATABASE ONLINE INCLUDE LOGS
steps.cmd: __o=$(mktemp); ( su - db2inst1 -c 'db2 -v '"'"'backup db lab online to /backups compress include logs without prompting'"'"' || exit $?' ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 6 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc
steps.out:
backup db lab online to /backups compress include logs without prompting

Backup successful. The timestamp for this backup image is : 20260914103434

steps.name: BACKUP DATABASE ONLINE INCREMENTAL
steps.cmd: __o=$(mktemp); ( su - db2inst1 -c 'db2 -v '"'"'backup db lab online incremental to /backups compress include logs without prompting'"'"' || exit $?' ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 6 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc
steps.out:
backup db lab online incremental to /backups compress include logs without prompting

Backup successful. The timestamp for this backup image is : 20260914103441

steps.name: RESTORE INCREMENTAL AUTOMATIC INTO labi + ROLLFORWARD
steps.cmd:
__o=$(mktemp); ( su - db2inst1 -c 'db2 -v '"'"'restore db lab incremental automatic from /backups taken at 20260914103441 into labi logtarget /backups/lt replace existing without prompting'"'"' || exit $?
db2 -v '"'"'rollforward db labi to end of logs and complete overflow log path (/backups/lt)'"'"' || exit $?' ) > $__o 2>&1; __rc=$?; tail -n 6 $__o; rm -f $__o; exit $__rc
